assets.ski: Use case: product-mockup. Create a photorealistic high-detail 3D asset reference of exactly ONE alpine downhill ski WITHOUT bindings, WITHOUT boot, WITHOUT skier. Isolated product on plain white background, entire object visible from tail to tip, long portrait composition, camera elevated three-quarter top view but minimal perspective distortion, ski running vertically from lower left tail to upper right tip. A realistic slender ski roughly 180 cm long and 12 cm wide, curved raised rounded shovel tip, subtle sidecut, modest rounded tail, thin laminated sidewalls and visible continuous polished steel edges. Mostly dark graphite satin topsheet, narrow lime and burnt orange angular inlays continuing the Alpine Apex game's existing equipment colors. Very restrained carbon fiber texture, fine believable wear along the steel edges, clean manufacturing seams. No text, no logos, no watermark, no extra objects, no environment, no snow, no multiple views. Keep all outlines easy to trace for Meshy image-to-3D; moderate soft studio lighting, no dramatic cast shadows. The ski must be thin sports equipment, never a thick board or snowboard.
assets.binding: Use case: product-mockup. High-detail photorealistic reference for Meshy image-to-3D: exactly ONE complete alpine ski binding assembly, consisting of front toe clamp and rear heel tower attached to a single slim flat mounting rail. No ski, no boot, no person. White seamless background, elevated three-quarter side view, full assembly framed with margin, long axis horizontal. Realistic engineered compact proportions around 40cm long, 12cm wide and 10cm tall. The center between toe and heel is OPEN for the boot sole; no solid block filling the boot space. Graphite molded housings, brushed metal fasteners, stainless toe wings, heel release lever, visible springs and recessed screw heads, tiny lime/orange accent panels matching dark alpine racing skis. Restrained realistic wear. Crisp manufactured shapes, rounded chamfers, believable mechanical details. No lettering or logos, no numbers, no watermark, no repeated copies, no floor pedestal. Clean soft studio lighting.
assets.pole: Use case: product-mockup. Photorealistic detailed 3D reference of exactly ONE straight alpine ski pole, full length shown on pure white background. Long portrait framing: handle at upper left, metal tip at lower right, almost vertical with only slight diagonal; use minimal perspective distortion. A long slender straight cylindrical carbon shaft, realistically about 115cm grip-to-tip. Black molded ergonomic rubber grip at top with a small black fabric wrist strap loop, a narrow lime/orange accent below the grip matching dark graphite racing skis. Shaft subtle satin carbon fiber and a few small orange/lime inlays, no branding. Near the bottom a small circular black snow basket with several radial cutouts, then a tapered metal ferrule and carbide point. Clearly separate shaft, grip, basket and tip silhouettes; realistic proportions with thin straight shaft, not a hiking stick or cane. Fine grip ribbing, strap woven texture, crisp machined ferrule detail. Entire pole in frame, no skis, no hands, no snow, no other objects, no watermark or text, no multiple views. Soft even product studio lighting.
